propositions: Under rich_text_cutover=cloud, the differ's local dedup key is produced by markdown round-trip encoding (escaping markdown-active chars) while the Jira-side key uses plain text decoding, causing markdown comments to never match their own landed bodies.

The send path encodes a decorated comment body, and markdown_to_adf degrades HTML-comment-decorated bodies to plain text, making the landed wire plain text while the undecorated local key round-trips through rich encoding — a mismatch.

The local dedup key must be derived by predicting the exact as-sent wire and decoding it with the same _normalize_comment_body decoder used on the Jira side, not by calling codec.normalize_outbound on the undecorated body.
Markdown comments within length limits incorrectly re-emit as duplicate mutations because the dedup key comparison fails despite the comment already landing on Jira.
The asymmetry was introduced by commit 27b868ba55, which moved the send path onto codec ADF encoding while leaving the Jira-side decode on adf_to_text.
